body:
## Problem

The conversation audit found repeated invalid mobile workspace commands, forgotten corrections, and two concurrent agents sharing a build log. The standalone briefing preview currently contains source evidence but no structured execution facts or prior-attempt record.

## Scope

Extend only `crates/briefing-lab` and its preview wrapper:

- Read pinned Cargo manifests to provide explicit manifest-based check commands and workspace facts.
- Allocate unique, external run artifact directories with request identity.
- Load bounded prior-attempt records, showing source/environment applicability and actual result status.
- Expose the new material in Markdown and JSON with explicit provenance and omissions.
- Add isolated tests for nested workspaces, stale attempts, concurrent artifact isolation, and result identity/status.
- Measure local preparation and preserve the existing source-only baseline.

Production routing, live claim enforcement, runtime deployment, and model calls stay outside this experiment. Existing work on Claude speed, Boat warm builds, and issue-flow fixes remains separately owned.

## Acceptance

Focused `briefing-lab` tests and formatting pass on the approved build host. The preview is runnable, examples are documented, and warm measurements include the added preparation work.
title: Briefing lab: add execution facts and prior-attempt records
